```yaml
name: Update uv.lock

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master, develop ]
    paths:
      - 'pyproject.toml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master, develop ]
    paths:
      - 'pyproject.toml'

jobs:
  update-lockfile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4
        with:
          version: "latest"

      - name: Check for anti-loop commit message
        id: check_message
        run: |
          COMMIT_MESSAGE="${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}"
          if [[ "$COMMIT_MESSAGE" == *"Update uv.lock"* ]]; then
            echo "anti_loop=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "anti_loop=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run uv lock
        if: steps.check_message.outputs.anti_loop != 'true'
        run: |
          uv lock

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check_message.outputs.anti_loop != 'true' && github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "Update uv.lock"
          add: "uv.lock"
          push: true

      - name: Fail if lockfile is out of sync
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          # Check if uv.lock is different from the one in the repository
          git diff --exit-code uv.lock || (echo "Error: uv.lock is out of sync. Please run 'uv lock' locally and commit the changes." && exit 1)
```
